locationPromptBody: We use your location to sort search results by distance and show how far each offering is from you.
locationBlocked: Location permission is blocked in your browser.
locationBlockedIntro: Location is currently blocked for this site. Unlock it first, then click Allow location:
locationUnlockStep1: Click the lock (or tune) icon next to the address bar
locationUnlockStep4: Return here and click Allow location
locationAllowBrowserHint: Clicking Allow location opens your browser’s permission popup. Choose Allow there to share your precise location.
locationHintAllow: Allow location to sort results by distance.
locationDenied: Location blocked for this site. Open Allow location access? to see how to unlock it.
